Achievements.Name: Deathless Destruction
Achievements.Description: Finish a destroy the object level without killing an enemy.

Achievements.Name: Nice Beating You
Achievements.Description: Finish the first set of levels by beating the first Pirate boss.

Achievements.Name: One Meeeeeelion Blocks!
Achievements.Description: Destroy a total of 1.000.000 blocks. All blocks you destroyed from all levels are counted.

Achievements.Name: I'll Show You Fits Of Rage
Achievements.Description: Shoot 20 enemies in 60 seconds. All game modes are counted.

Achievements.Name: You're Like Some Kind Of Robot
Been There, Shot That
Achievements.Description: Use every power-up at least once.

Achievements.Name: Two Thumb Master
Achievements.Description: Defeat BlockBeard to finish the single player campaign.

Achievements.Name: On A Gamer's Diet
Achievements.Description: Shoot 50 zombies, 50 robots, 50 pirates and 50 soldiers, all levels are counted.

Achievements.Name: Natural Born Gamer
Achievements.Description: Shoot 5000 enemies in total, all levels are counted.

Achievements.Name: The Things I've Seen
Achievements.Description: Shoot every type of enemy at least once, all levels are counted.

Achievements.Name: A Wilhelm Scream
Achievements.Description: Die while fighting BlockBeard on the final level.

Achievements.Name: One Shot, Thrice The Score
Achievements.Description: Using the Triple Rocket power up, kill 3 enemies with one shot.
